'''Jeza Goloc''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] who operated from a [[Rebel Camp (Lok)|camp]] on [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:TFsT" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Jeza Goloc was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TFsT" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Jeza Goloc was added to the game with the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Imperial Theme Park|Imperial Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:TFsT" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Update Notes 6.12: September 13 2007|Chapter 6.12]]" update, on [[September 13]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 6.12: Masters of the Wild">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67417&month=092007|text=Chapter 6.12: Masters of the Wild}}</ref>
